$comment: Shapes the wire conventions (CONTRIBUTING-SPECS.md "Wire conventions for common members") do not mean, keyed by slug, then by "<rule> <member>", each with the reason. Read by scripts/lib/wire-conventions.mjs. An entry is for a member whose name matches a convention's but whose meaning is something else — never for a spec that would rather not follow one. An entry no longer found is reported as stale.

messaging/queue/list.truncated-flag truncated: Not a paging flag: it says the periodic queue survey stopped before covering every account. `nextCursor` already says whether more pages remain.

auth/_shared.duration-unit timeout: WebAuthn's PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions/RequestOptions `timeout` (milliseconds), carried verbatim as external vocabulary (SPEC §4.10 rule 5).

registry/_shared.instant-name time: ToIP Trust Registry Query Protocol (TRQP) vocabulary, carried verbatim (SPEC §4.10 rule 5): the query context's `time`, the instant to evaluate the query as of.

did-management/did/log.instant-name versionTime: did:webvh's log-entry `versionTime`, carried verbatim as external vocabulary (SPEC §4.10 rule 5).

did-management/did/info.instant-name latestVersionTime: The latest log entry's did:webvh `versionTime`, named after it beside `latestVersionId` (did:webvh `versionId`).

hcp/_shared.timestamp-name at: Human Context Protocol (HCP) 2.0-draft-3 member names carried verbatim as external vocabulary (SPEC §4.10 rule 5): evidence `verification.at` (4.2.2), the instant the provider last verified the evidence, and delegation `ended.at` (17.2, 17.6), the instant the delegation ended. They are kept so that the objects an export carries pass through unchanged (5.4.1, 5.4.3).
hcp/_shared.timestamp-name timestamp: Human Context Protocol (HCP) 2.0-draft-3 audit event `timestamp` (8.2), the instant the event occurred, carried verbatim as external vocabulary (SPEC §4.10 rule 5) so that an event read with hcp/audit/read is the event an export carries (5.4.1).

hcp/import.timestamp-name timestamp: Human Context Protocol (HCP) 2.0-draft-3 audit event `timestamp` (8.2), carried verbatim as external vocabulary (SPEC §4.10 rule 5) in `ImportedAuditEvent`, HCP's own audit-event shape, so that an export written to HCP's schema alone is taken unchanged (5.4.1, 5.4.3).
